description: Source file implementing a UHD radio session with functions for setting time, frequency, gain, starting/stopping streams, and managing hardware configuration for USRP devices.

classes.name: radio_session_uhd_impl
classes.description: Implements a UHD radio session managing USRP device configuration, streaming, and synchronization.

classes.name: radio_factory_uhd_impl
classes.description: Factory class for creating radio session instances.

methods.name: set_time_to_gps_time
methods.description: Sets USRP time based on GPS sensor reading.

methods.name: wait_sensor_locked
methods.description: Waits until a specified sensor (e.g., GPS lock) is locked or timeout occurs.

methods.name: set_tx_gain_unprotected
methods.description: Sets transmit gain for a specified port.

methods.name: set_rx_gain_unprotected
methods.description: Sets receive gain for a specified port.

methods.name: set_tx_freq
methods.description: Sets transmit frequency for a given stream.

methods.name: set_rx_freq
methods.description: Sets receive frequency for a given stream.

methods.name: start_rx_stream
methods.description: Starts all receive streams at a specified initial time.

methods.name: radio_session_uhd_impl
methods.description: Constructor initializing UHD device, configuring clock, time, and streams.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all transmit and receive streams.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts all transmit and receive streams.

methods.name: read_current_time
methods.description: Retrieves current device time in ticks.
